s.how: Cut 2 sheets puff pastry into strips and wrap 24 cocktail franks. Brush with egg and bake at 200C for 18 minutes. Serve with sauce.
Slice 4 red apples and serve with 200g peanut butter for dipping. Serve straight away on a big platter in the middle of the table.

m.how: Lay 4 salmon fillets on foil with lemon slices, dill and butter, wrap and bake at 200C for 15 minutes. Serve with 600g boiled potatoes.

w.how: Toss 5 sliced apples with 60g sugar and cinnamon. Rub 100g butter into 120g flour, 60g oats and 100g brown sugar, scatter over and bake at 180C for 35 minutes.

d.how: Brew 60g ground coffee with 1L water in a plunger and serve with milk. Make it just before the film starts and keep the jug cold.
